item.text:
Implemented scheduled report delivery in [src/server.js](/workspace/src/server.js):

- Browser UI at `/`
- Schedule CRUD API:
  - `GET /api/report-schedules`
  - `POST /api/report-schedules`
  - `PATCH /api/report-schedules/:id`
  - `DELETE /api/report-schedules/:id`
  - `POST /api/report-schedules/:id/run`
- Daily and weekly schedules with UTC times
- Automatic scheduler polling every minute
- Pluggable delivery function, with local console delivery by default
- Manual delivery tracking
- Input validation and recurrence suppression

Verified with `npm test` and schedule/delivery recurrence smoke tests.
